DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_context_mutation_inbox)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_context_summary WHERE invalidation_epoch = 2) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot remove dialog teacher context mutation fencing after events or epoch-2 summaries exist';
    END IF;
END
$$;

DROP TABLE teacher_dialog_context_mutation_fence;
DROP TABLE teacher_dialog_context_mutation_inbox;

ALTER TABLE teacher_context_summary
    DROP COLUMN invalidation_epoch;
